svg.text: talk.01 · ROUND 4 · THREE CUTS FROM THE PUSH-TO-TALK LINE
one family: 30° chamfer · thumb dial on the chamfer · slanted left lever · coiled orange cable on top · small hatch
TENTATIVE · NOT A FINAL DESIGN
original concepts · dimensions are guesses
No flipping, tilting or stacking this time: shapes come from old radio gear, details come from the checklist.
A · HANDIE
lineage: the walkie-talkie brick (Handie-Talkie, push-to-talk on the side)
side · desk
front (dashed box = zoom)
3 CM DETAIL
REAR · small hatch + stand
hero: the slanted PTT lever on a chamfered brick
borrows: grip ribs, side PTT, top dial like a radio volume knob
graphic layer: 1-4 channel numbers, HOLD/CLICK/PUSH icons,
ON AIR lamp, brass screws, orange coiled cable
stand and cover: ONE small hatch that swings out as the stand
+ most 'real radio'; one motif; easy to print
+ opening the stand opens the bay
- the bay is exposed while the stand is out
- slab with a chamfer: not yet a strong silhouette
B · PALM
lineage: the CB hand microphone (waisted body, long PTT bar, coiled cord)
side · desk
front (dashed box = zoom)
3 CM DETAIL
REAR · small hatch + stand
hero: the waisted 'palm mic' body and the long metal bar
borrows: the CB mic's waist that fits the hand, bar down the side
graphic layer: same icons and numbers, cream on black,
metal bar, brass screws, orange coiled cable
stand: small U in a groove · cover: round hatch (coin shape)
+ strongest silhouette; the waist is where the thumb goes
+ black and metal with an orange cable is very striking
- the waist costs inner volume and print is harder
- long bar needs a pivot that survives FDM
C · POD
lineage: the small bar-shaped MP3 player (one chamfer, one round control)
side · desk
front (dashed box = zoom)
3 CM DETAIL
REAR · small hatch + stand
hero: a slim white bar with one big round dial ring
borrows: the MP3 player's slim bar and single round control
graphic layer: ring ticks 1-4, 'talk' on the button, icons,
ON AIR window, brass screws, orange coiled cable
stand: small U · cover: small rounded hatch
+ pocketable and very handheld; clean and modern
+ the ring is a good fidget and states the mode
- slim (13 mm): tight for the board and lever
- least like a radio; leans towards a music player
